verses.original: לַ֭מְנַצֵּחַ שִׁ֣יר מִזְמ֑וֹר הָרִ֥יעוּ לֵ֝אלֹהִים כָּל־ הָאָֽרֶץ׃
verses.transliteration: lam·naṣ·ṣê·aḥ šîr miz·mō·wr hā·rî·‘ū lê·lō·hîm kāl- hā·’ā·reṣ
verses.literal: For the choirmaster A song A Psalm Make a joyful noise to God all the earth

verses.original: זַמְּר֥וּ כְבֽוֹד־ שְׁמ֑וֹ שִׂ֥ימוּ תְּהִלָּתֽוֹ׃ כָ֝ב֗וֹד
verses.transliteration: zam·mə·rū ḵə·ḇō·wḏ- šə·mōw śî·mū tə·hil·lā·ṯōw ḵā·ḇō·wḏ
verses.literal: Sing the glory of His name make His praise glorious

verses.original: אִמְר֣וּ לֵ֭אלֹהִים מַה־ נּוֹרָ֣א מַעֲשֶׂ֑יךָ לְךָ֣ בְּרֹ֥ב עֻ֝זְּךָ֗ אֹיְבֶֽיךָ׃ יְֽכַחֲשׁ֖וּ
verses.transliteration: ’im·rū lê·lō·hîm mah- nō·w·rā ma·‘ă·śe·ḵā lə·ḵā bə·rōḇ ‘uz·zə·ḵā ’ō·yə·ḇe·ḵā yə·ḵa·ḥă·šū
verses.literal: Say to God How awesome are Your deeds So great is Your power that Your enemies cower before You

verses.original: כָּל־ הָאָ֤רֶץ׀ יִשְׁתַּחֲו֣וּ לְ֭ךָ וִֽיזַמְּרוּ־ לָ֑ךְ יְזַמְּר֖וּ שִׁמְךָ֣ סֶֽלָה׃
verses.transliteration: kāl- hā·’ā·reṣ yiš·ta·ḥă·wū lə·ḵā wî·zam·mə·rū- lāḵ yə·zam·mə·rū šim·ḵā se·lāh
verses.literal: All the earth bows down to You they sing praise to You they sing praise to Your name Selah

verses.original: לְכ֣וּ וּ֭רְאוּ מִפְעֲל֣וֹת אֱלֹהִ֑ים נוֹרָ֥א עֲ֝לִילָ֗ה עַל־ בְּנֵ֥י אָדָֽם׃
verses.transliteration: lə·ḵū ū·rə·’ū mip̄·‘ă·lō·wṯ ’ĕ·lō·hîm nō·w·rā ‘ă·lî·lāh ‘al- bə·nê ’ā·ḏām
verses.literal: Come and see the works of God how awesome are His deeds toward vvv mankind

verses.original: הָ֤פַךְ יָ֨ם׀ לְֽיַבָּשָׁ֗ה יַֽעַבְר֣וּ בַּ֭נָּהָר בְרָ֑גֶל שָׁ֝֗ם נִשְׂמְחָה־ בּֽוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: hā·p̄aḵ yām lə·yab·bā·šāh ya·‘aḇ·rū ban·nā·hār ḇə·rā·ḡel šām niś·mə·ḥāh- bōw
verses.literal: He turned the sea into dry land they passed through the waters on foot there we rejoiced in Him

verses.original: מֹ֘שֵׁ֤ל עוֹלָ֗ם בִּגְבוּרָת֨וֹ׀ עֵ֭ינָיו תִּצְפֶּ֑ינָה בַּגּוֹיִ֣ם אַל־ הַסּוֹרְרִ֓ים׀ יָרִימוּ לָ֣מוֹ סֶֽלָה׃
verses.transliteration: mō·šêl ‘ō·w·lām biḡ·ḇū·rā·ṯōw ‘ê·nāw tiṣ·pe·nāh bag·gō·w·yim ’al- has·sō·wr·rîm yå̄·rī·mū lā·mōw se·lāh
verses.literal: He rules forever by His power His eyes watch the nations Do not let the rebellious exalt themselves Selah

verses.original: בָּרְכ֖וּ אֱלֹהֵ֑ינוּ עַמִּ֥ים׀ ק֣וֹל תְּהִלָּתֽוֹ׃ וְ֝הַשְׁמִ֗יעוּ
verses.transliteration: bā·rə·ḵū ’ĕ·lō·hê·nū ‘am·mîm qō·wl tə·hil·lā·ṯōw wə·haš·mî·‘ū
verses.literal: Bless our God O peoples let the sound of His praise be heard

verses.original: הַשָּׂ֣ם נַ֭פְשֵׁנוּ בַּֽחַיִּ֑ים וְלֹֽא־ נָתַ֖ן רַגְלֵֽנוּ׃ לַמּ֣וֹט
verses.transliteration: haś·śām nap̄·šê·nū ba·ḥay·yîm wə·lō- nā·ṯan raḡ·lê·nū lam·mō·wṭ
verses.literal: He preserves our lives and keeps . . . our feet from slipping

verses.original: כִּֽי־ אֱלֹהִ֑ים בְחַנְתָּ֥נוּ צְ֝רַפְתָּ֗נוּ כָּֽסֶף׃ כִּצְרָף־
verses.transliteration: kî- ’ĕ·lō·hîm ḇə·ḥan·tā·nū ṣə·rap̄·tā·nū kā·sep̄ kiṣ·rāp̄-
verses.literal: For You , O God have tested us You have refined us like silver . . .

verses.original: הֲבֵאתָ֥נוּ בַמְּצוּדָ֑ה שַׂ֖מְתָּ מוּעָקָ֣ה בְמָתְנֵֽינוּ׃
verses.transliteration: hă·ḇê·ṯā·nū ḇam·mə·ṣū·ḏāh śam·tā mū·‘ā·qāh ḇə·mā·ṯə·nê·nū
verses.literal: You led us into the net You laid burdens on our backs

verses.original: אֱנ֗וֹשׁ הִרְכַּ֥בְתָּ לְרֹ֫אשֵׁ֥נוּ בָּֽאנוּ־ בָאֵ֥שׁ וּבַמַּ֑יִם וַ֝תּוֹצִיאֵ֗נוּ לָֽרְוָיָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: ’ĕ·nō·wōš hir·kaḇ·tā lə·rō·šê·nū bā·nū- ḇā·’êš ū·ḇam·ma·yim wat·tō·w·ṣî·’ê·nū lā·rə·wā·yāh
verses.literal: You let men ride over our heads we went through fire and water but You brought us into abundance

verses.original: אָב֣וֹא בֵיתְךָ֣ בְעוֹל֑וֹת אֲשַׁלֵּ֖ם נְדָרָֽי׃ לְךָ֣
verses.transliteration: ’ā·ḇō·w ḇê·ṯə·ḵā ḇə·‘ō·w·lō·wṯ ’ă·šal·lêm nə·ḏā·rāy lə·ḵā
verses.literal: I will enter Your house with burnt offerings I will fulfill my vows to You

verses.original: אֲשֶׁר־ שְׂפָתָ֑י פָּצ֥וּ פִּ֝֗י וְדִבֶּר־ בַּצַּר־ לִֽי׃
verses.transliteration: ’ă·šer- śə·p̄ā·ṯāy pā·ṣū pî wə·ḏib·ber- baṣ·ṣar- lî
verses.literal: [the vows] that my lips promised and my mouth spoke in my distress

verses.original: אַעֲלֶה־ לָּ֭ךְ מֵחִ֣ים עֹ֘ל֤וֹת עִם־ קְטֹ֣רֶת אֵילִ֑ים אֶ֥עֱשֶֽׂה בָקָ֖ר עִם־ עַתּוּדִ֣ים סֶֽלָה׃
verses.transliteration: ’a·‘ă·leh- lāḵ mê·ḥîm ‘ō·lō·wṯ ‘im- qə·ṭō·reṯ ’ê·lîm ’e·‘ĕ·śeh ḇā·qār ‘im- ‘at·tū·ḏîm se·lāh
verses.literal: I will offer You fatlings as burnt offerings with the fragrant smoke of rams I will offer bulls and goats Selah

verses.original: לְכֽוּ־ שִׁמְע֣וּ כָּל־ יִרְאֵ֣י אֱלֹהִ֑ים וַ֭אֲסַפְּרָה אֲשֶׁ֖ר עָשָׂ֣ה לְנַפְשִֽׁי׃
verses.transliteration: lə·ḵū- šim·‘ū kāl- yir·’ê ’ĕ·lō·hîm wa·’ă·sap·pə·rāh ’ă·šer ‘ā·śāh lə·nap̄·šî
verses.literal: Come and listen all you who fear God and I will declare what He has done for me

verses.original: קָרָ֑אתִי אֵלָ֥יו פִּֽי־ וְ֝רוֹמַ֗ם תַּ֣חַת לְשׁוֹנִֽי׃
verses.transliteration: qā·rā·ṯî ’ê·lāw pî- wə·rō·w·mam ta·ḥaṯ lə·šō·w·nî
verses.literal: I cried out to Him with my mouth and praised Him with my tongue

verses.original: אִם־ רָאִ֣יתִי אָ֭וֶן בְלִבִּ֑י אֲדֹנָֽי׃ לֹ֖א יִשְׁמַ֣ע׀
verses.transliteration: ’im- rā·’î·ṯî ’ā·wen ḇə·lib·bî ’ă·ḏō·nāy lō yiš·ma‘
verses.literal: If I had cherished iniquity in my heart the Lord would not have listened

verses.original: אֱלֹהִ֑ים אָ֭כֵן שָׁמַ֣ע הִ֝קְשִׁ֗יב בְּק֣וֹל תְּפִלָּתִֽי׃
verses.transliteration: ’ĕ·lō·hîm ’ā·ḵên šā·ma‘ hiq·šîḇ bə·qō·wl tə·p̄il·lā·ṯî
verses.literal: But God has surely heard He has attended to the sound of my prayer

verses.original: בָּר֥וּךְ אֱלֹהִ֑ים אֲשֶׁ֥ר לֹֽא־ הֵסִ֘יר תְּפִלָּתִ֥י מֵאִתִּֽי׃ וְ֝חַסְדּ֗וֹ
verses.transliteration: bā·rūḵ ’ĕ·lō·hîm ’ă·šer lō- hê·sîr tə·p̄il·lā·ṯî mê·’it·tî wə·ḥas·dōw
verses.literal: Blessed [be] God who has not rejected my prayer or withheld from me His loving devotion
